messages.content: I think I've been keeping people at arm's length without fully realizing it.
Honestly, that's a genuinely useful thing to notice about yourself. What tipped you off?
A friend said I never really let anyone all the way in.
That's honestly worth sitting with rather than dismissing - people close to you usually notice patterns before we're ready to see them ourselves.
I think I'm scared of being fully known and then rejected anyway.
That fear makes a lot of sense, honestly - but partial closeness protects you from partial rejection while also blocking full connection either way.
